features.rationale: The package pricing lists a full pass together with accommodation, so accommodation is included in the pass.
The listed package includes breakfasts for each night.
The description lists Pool Parties as part of the event.
Afternoon Parties are listed, which are daytime socials.
The event offers dance workshops across eight halls.
The description promises spectacular shows as part of the event.
Workshops in 8 halls and parties in 5 halls mean more than one dance room.
A BALKAN COMPETITION with several categories is announced.
The venue is the hotel itself, and the accommodation packages are sold for that same hotel, so the parties and lodging are in the same venue.
